title: statusline r20 UX: failure signal under-determined between exit conventions
description: Round 20. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Defect: 'signalling failure cleanly' admits exit-0-plus-diagnostic and non-zero readings — two competent implementations diverge, the fixture has no observable, and automation gets a signal on write failure but not read-withdrawal. Citations verified: contract:187, :162. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the observable defined: init exits zero when installation itself succeeds; any not-installed statusline outcome — write failure or withdrawn offer under the accept flag — sets the wiring-not-installed marker in init's machine-readable outcome summary, which automation checks instead of the exit code; both seeds assert the marker).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the observable defined — init exits zero when installation itself succeeds; any not-installed statusline outcome (write failure, or read-withdrawal under the accept flag) sets the wiring-not-installed marker in init's machine-readable outcome summary, which automation checks; both seeds assert the marker, and read and write failure modes are detected identically. Revision: Install behaviors criterion.
